author: ctfdn_official
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. author: saltoparticipation
title: Call for Illustrators - Democracy Theme
content: 🎨 Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026. Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio.
